basic_details.job_title: SXC Jaipur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Human Resource Trainee, Global Client Strategist Intern and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: HumanHire Corp, a private global talent solutions and recruitment organisation, has opened 6-month on-site internships for students of all academic streams in three roles: Global Client Strategist Intern (night shift), Human Resource Trainee (day shift) and Research Analyst Trainee (day shift). The stipend is up to ₹12,000 per month. The opportunity was announced on 16 November 2026 by the Training & Placement and Institution–Industry Cell (TIPC) of St. Xavier's College Jaipur. Students can apply through a Google Form till 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About HumanHire Corp
content_sections.text: HumanHire Corp is described in the notice as a global talent solutions and recruitment organisation with offices in Delhi, Pune, Jaipur, London, Delaware and Kuala Lumpur. It supports international recruitment, client relationships and business operations across various markets. Its sister brand, Being & Brand (B&B), provides marketing services to clients across global markets. The notice is issued by St. Xavier's College Jaipur, which is affiliated to the University of Rajasthan, Jaipur.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice does not print the number of seats. It lists three positions with their shifts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The internship is open to students of all academic streams, including technical and non-technical disciplines. The notice names no specific degree or year of study. The eligibility criteria printed for all three posts are: Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to learn and adapt to a professional work environment. Interest in gaining practical industry exposure. Candidates must be comfortable with the on-site / work-from-office arrangement. Students applying for the Global Client Strategist Intern position should be comfortable working night shifts. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The notice prints the stipend as "up to" ₹12,000 per month and does not say how the exact amount is decided.

content_sections.heading: HumanHire Corp Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will gain practical exposure in the following areas, depending on their respective roles. International client outreach and global client relationship management. Recruitment processes, talent acquisition and HR operations. Business research, data gathering and analysis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HumanHire Corp Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/c9J2XHHenPaB5afJA (also linked under Official Links below). Submit the application on the form by 18 November 2026. Wait for the registration process and recruitment schedule, which the notice says will be communicated separately. The notice does not list documents or form fields. For further details, contact Dr. Renu Jadon (TIPC Coordinator), Dr. Arpita Banerjee (TIPC Assistant Coordinator) or Ms. Sonali Dubey (TPO, TIPC) at [email protected] . The college's phone numbers are +91 9828726366 / 9571077348 and its address is Nevta - Mahapura Road, Jaipur - 302029, Rajasthan, India.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The company is open to conducting an on-campus or off-campus recruitment drive on a mutually convenient date. Further details about the registration process and the recruitment schedule will be communicated separately.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are open in the HumanHire Corp internship?
faq.answer: Three posts are open: Global Client Strategist Intern, Human Resource Trainee and Research Analyst Trainee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 18 November 2026, through the Google Form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is up to ₹12,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How long is the internship?
Q5. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Students of all academic streams, technical and non-technical, can apply. They should have good communication and interpersonal skills, willingness to learn and adapt to a professional environment, and interest in practical industry exposure.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form linked in the notice before 18 November 2026. Registration process and recruitment schedule details will be communicated separately.

faq.question: Q7. Is night shift compulsory?
faq.answer: Night shift applies to the Global Client Strategist Intern position, so applicants for it should be comfortable working night shifts. Human Resource Trainee and Research Analyst Trainee are day-shift posts.

faq.question: Q8. Is the internship work from home?
faq.answer: No. The work mode is on-site / work from office, and candidates must be comfortable with that arrangement.

faq.question: Q9. Will there be a recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The company is open to an on-campus or off-campus recruitment drive on a mutually convenient date. The schedule will be communicated separately.
